IMG-A.en: Photorealistic 9:16 vertical portrait photo, medium close-up from mid-chest up, subject centered, eyes on the upper third line, a little headroom. Subject: the same East Asian woman in her early thirties as in the reference image — shoulder-length black hair neatly tied back in a low ponytail with no loose strands near the face, natural makeup, wearing a solid navy blazer over a plain white crew-neck top, no jewelry, no glasses. She faces the lens directly with a relaxed neutral expression, lips relaxed and gently closed, shoulders relaxed and level, hands out of view below the frame. Background: plain warm light-grey seamless wall. Large soft key light 45 degrees from camera left, soft fill from camera right, subtle hair rim light, neutral 5600K. True-to-life skin texture, sharp focus on the eyes, natural color. No text, no logo.
